recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** issued a three-line whip to its Lok Sabha members urging them to support the party's stance during the upcoming special session of Parliament, which will focus on amending the women’s reservation law and carrying out a delimitation exercise. The government plans to increase the strength of both the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 50%, reserving 272 seats for women lawmakers. **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and party chairperson Sonia Gandhi have expressed concerns about the timing of the special session, arguing that it is being held in the middle of an election campaign and that delimitation should be addressed separately.

recent_articles.title: Support Women’s Reservation Bill amendments: PM to parties - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** wrote to heads of political parties urging their cooperation in passing amendments to the **Women’s Reservation Act**, 2023, calling it a moment for responsibility towards women. **Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge** countered by demanding an all-party meeting before the special sitting on the amendments and questioned the timing amid ongoing state elections.  Kharge argued that the government's proposed changes to delimitation based on the 2011 Census without using population as a metric for representation were not discussed with the opposition, raising concerns about transparency and democratic participation.

recent_articles.title: Rijiju writes to Kharge, says delay in women’s quota law will deny justice to millions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kiren Rijiju**, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, responded to **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress President, who criticized the government's push for the Women's Reservation Act implementation.  Rijiju emphasized that the law is about fulfilling promises to Indian women and urged opposition parties to support its implementation in 2029. He stated that delaying action on the matter is unjust and called for a united effort towards "Nari Shakti".

recent_articles.title: Punjab: Special session on sacrilege law an attempt by AAP Government to cover up its failures, says Congress chief - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amrinder Singh Raja Warring**, **Bhagwant Mann**, and the **AAP Government** in Punjab are at odds over a proposed law to punish sacrilege.  The **Punjab Congress** president criticized the special session called by the AAP government, claiming it is an attempt to distract from their failure to punish those responsible for previous sacrilege incidents. Warring also questioned the sincerity of the AAP's intentions and accused them of using the issue as a political tool. He further pointed out that the law lacks any real deterrent effect without proper punishment.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi, other Congress leaders to campaign in T.N. soon - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Girish Chodankar**, AICC in-charge for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, announced that **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and **Priyanka Gandhi** will campaign in the state soon.  Chodankar explained that the leaders' schedules were pre-fixed, with **Rahul Gandhi** having a program in Kerala and **Stalin** having a program in Tamil Nadu. He stated that only opposition parties are attempting to create an issue out of the situation.

recent_articles.title: Government hurrying women’s quota law implementation for political mileage: Kharge to PM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** decision to call a special Parliament session on the Women's Reservation Act, arguing it appears politically motivated.  Kharge demanded an all-party meeting to discuss delimitation issues linked to the law, stating that without details of the proposed changes, meaningful discussions are impossible. He expressed concern about the government's past record and urged for a transparent process involving all parties before implementing the amendments. The exchange of letters between **Prime Minister Modi** and Kharge comes ahead of Parliament's special session from April 16 to 18 where the government plans to implement the Women's Reservation Act and increase Lok Sabha seats.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi, other Congress leaders to campaign in T.N. soon - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **All India Congress Committee (AICC)** in-charge for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, **Girish Chodankar**, announced that **Rahul Gandhi** and **Priyanka Gandhi** will campaign in the state soon.  Chodankar explained that **Gandhi**'s visit to Puducherry was pre-planned with a separate program in Kerala, while **Stalin** had a program in Tamil Nadu. He stated that only opposition parties are creating an issue about the meeting. Chodankar also responded to **Vijay**, founder of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam, who claimed "true Congressmen" would be with him, stating that true Congressmen will stay with the party.

recent_articles.title: Congress discusses women’s reservation law and delimitation; Kharge to meet other Opposition leaders for joint strategy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress Working Committee** (CWC) discussed the government's proposed delimitation exercise and women's reservation law implementation. The party plans to formulate a joint strategy for the upcoming special session of Parliament, aiming to implement the women's reservation law by 2029 and increase the strength of the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 50%.  **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Rahul Gandhi** expressed concerns about the proposed changes, emphasizing the need for wider consultation on delimitation. The party also criticized the government's move to implement a predetermined number of seats for women, arguing that it undermines proportional representation for other marginalized groups.

recent_articles.title: High enthusiasm, long queues mark polling as Puducherry shatters record - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Puducherry** registered an unprecedented 89.74% voter turnout in the 2026 Assembly election, surpassing previous records.  Long queues of voters were observed across urban, rural and coastal constituencies as enthusiasm was high from early morning.  Key figures participating in the election included **Lieutenant Governor K. Kailashnathan**, **Chief Minister N. Rangasamy**, former Chief Minister V. Narayanasamy, and several other prominent politicians. While no major complaints arose regarding the polling process, allegations of voter inducement and minor scuffles were reported from two constituencies.

recent_articles.title: Why did the Congress withdraw its candidate from Baramati at the last minute? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** and **NCP(SP)** leaders, including Sunetra Pawar, met with **Maharashtra Congress** president Harshawardhan Sapkal to request the withdrawal of their candidate from the Baramati by-election.  The Pawars argued for a united front against a competing candidate, while **Congress** leaders expressed disappointment over the lack of outreach from the **NCP**. The **Congress** eventually backed down and agreed to withdraw its candidate in response to pressure from allies and the **Pawar family**.

recent_articles.title: Assam sees record voter turnout of over 85% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam** recorded its highest-ever voter turnout in the Assembly elections, with 85.62% of voters casting their ballots on Thursday (April 9, 2026).  The state witnessed largely peaceful voting despite reports of violence and allegations of proxy voting. **Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma** hailed the historic turnout, attributing it to a desire to protect Assam's land, identity, and culture from illegal infiltration and demographic aggression. State Congress president **Gaurav Gogoi** thanked voters for their participation in the election, urging the Election Commission to ensure the security of EVMs and accurate vote counting on May 4th.

recent_articles.title: Sharan Prakash Patil takes umbrage at remarks by BJP leaders against Mallikarjun Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. Sharan Prakash Patil**, **Medical Education Minister**, criticized **BJP leaders** for making "irresponsible" and "disrespectful" remarks against **AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge**.  Patil condemned the comments, arguing that they are being blown out of proportion and comparing them to past instances of similar attacks by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on Congress leaders. He also questioned the basis for comparisons made by **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** against **Jawaharlal Nehru**, emphasizing the Congress's commitment to non-alignment and condemnation of aggression without supporting war.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026 LIVE: Voting begins in 126 constituencies across the State; BJP eyes third term as Congress-led alliance mounts challenge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam** is holding its 126-member Assembly elections on April 9, 2026. The **BJP**, led by Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, is seeking a third consecutive term in power while the **Congress**, under the leadership of **Gaurav Gogoi**, aims to reclaim the state from the BJP. A total of 722 candidates are competing, including leaders like **Debabrata Saikia** and **Badruddin Ajmal**. Polling will take place across 31,490 polling stations in 35 districts.

recent_articles.title: Priyank Kharge directs zilla panchayat CEOs to ensure there is no drinking water shortage in Karnataka villages - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, Karnataka's Minister for Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, directed **ZP CEOs** to ensure no village faces drinking water shortages during the summer.  He reviewed district preparedness, emphasizing special funds for managing summer exigencies and directing officials to assess and revive non-functional RO plants.  Kharge also instructed timely deployment of water tankers and utilization of private borewells, ensuring prompt payments to service providers and operationalizing taluk-level helplines for complaints.

recent_articles.title: Mallikarjun Kharge expresses regret over 'illiterate' remark, says he has highest of respect for Gujaratis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** issued a statement expressing regret for his controversial remarks about the people of Gujarat during an election speech in Kerala. He clarified that he never intended to offend the people of Gujarat and maintains respect for them. The **BJP** demanded an apology from **Kharge**, accusing him of making "shameless, demeaning and utterly despicable" statements.

recent_articles.title: Assam Police team visits Khera’s Delhi residence - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the **Assam Chief Minister**, declared that his police will pursue **Pawan Khera**, a Congress leader, to uncover those who provided him with allegedly forged documents tarnishing his family's reputation.  **Khera** has been accused of making false claims about **Riniki Bhuyan Sharma**, the wife of the CM, including allegations of foreign passports and shell companies. The Assam police have sought permission from Telangana authorities to investigate **Khera** after he was not found at his New Delhi residence.  The Congress party has requested investigations by the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** or **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** into the accusations.

recent_articles.title: BJP petitions DG-IGP seeking arrest of Mallikarjun Kharge for alleged provocative speech - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** in Karnataka filed a petition with the **DG & IGP** against **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the **AICC president**, accusing him of making a provocative speech against the **RSS** and **BJP**. The delegation alleged that his statement "incited Muslims" and endangered the lives of BJP and RSS members nationwide. They demanded Mr. Kharge's immediate arrest.

recent_articles.title: CM Patel flags ‘nation first’ ideology; BJP hits out at Kharge at foundation day event - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhupendra Patel**, **Gujarat Chief Minister**, and **Jagdish Vishwakarma**, the state BJP president, addressed party workers at the 47th Foundation Day celebrations.  Patel emphasized the BJP's commitment to serving the nation with a "nation first" approach while urging calm in response to rumors and misinformation. He praised Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah** for their leadership and highlighted the state's economic growth under the BJP's rule. Vishwakarma stressed the party's dedication to democratic values and its commitment to national pride, calling for intensified efforts ahead of upcoming local body elections.

recent_articles.title: Akash Vishwanath More of Congress to contest Baramati Bypoll - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has selected **Advocate Akash Vishwanath More** as its candidate for the Baramati assembly by-election. The party's decision was made after the seat became vacant following the death of incumbent MLA and Deputy Chief Minister, **Ajit Pawar**.  **Sunetra Pawar**, wife of **Ajit Pawar**, will be filing her nomination from the Mahayuti.

recent_articles.title: Drinking water scarcity in 324 villages across 60 taluks in 20 districts in Karnataka: Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, Minister for Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, announced that drinking water scarcity has been reported in 324 villages across 60 taluks in Karnataka.  The government is addressing the issue by allocating ₹60 crore to districts, releasing funds for pending bills, and providing funding for repairing purified drinking water units. Water quality testing is being conducted regularly, with alternative safe sources arranged where contamination is confirmed. Officials at various levels are monitoring supply and conducting review meetings to ensure uninterrupted water access during summer months.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan jibes become central to BJP’s Assam poll narrative - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Chief Minister of Assam, has criticized **Lurinjyoti Gogoi**, the AJP candidate for Guwahati Central constituency, for his alleged links to "anti-national" elements.  Sarma also attacked **Sujata Gurung Chowdhury**, Kunki Chowdhury's mother, for publicly supporting Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid, both accused in the 2020 Delhi riots case. The controversy has drawn attention to Pakistan as a topic of discussion in the Assam election. **Saadulla**, a former Prime Minister of Assam, is being used by the BJP to highlight alleged infiltration attempts into the state during his tenure.

recent_articles.title: ‘BJP loot diwas’: Congress slams price hike of essential commodities - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge criticized the **Modi government** for its handling of rising prices of essential commodities, accusing them of "looting the public and plundering the nation" amidst a crisis.  He cited soaring LPG and fuel costs, increased prices on medicines and construction materials, and other price hikes as evidence of the government's failure to address citizens' concerns. Kharge called for relief from the current economic hardship faced by common citizens, farmers, laborers, and MSME industries.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams attack on its candidate in Assam election - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunil Kumar Chhetri**, the Congress candidate for the Naduar Assembly constituency, was attacked by unidentified men during his election campaign in Assam.  The incident occurred near Napam Bypass and resulted in Chhetri falling and requiring medical attention. **Gaurav Gogoi**, the state Congress president, demanded the arrest of the perpetrators while **Ripun Bora**, a Congress leader, condemned the attack as an act of fear by the ruling BJP. The **Bharatiya Gorkha Parisangh (BGP)** also expressed outrage over the incident and called for enhanced security for Chhetri.

recent_articles.title: The political does not get personal in campaign in parts of Assam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam's** 2026 Assembly elections are seeing a notable shift towards civility, with candidates in constituencies like Jorhat, Dispur, and Tamulpur engaging in polite interactions. **Hitendra Nath Goswami**, the BJP candidate from Jorhat, acknowledges his younger rival, **Gaurav Gogoi**, is articulate but doesn't guarantee victory.  **Jayanta Kumar Das**, an Independent candidate in Guwahati, maintains a respectful stance despite his past disagreements with the BJP. In Dispur, candidates like **Santanu Borah** and **Diplu Ranjan Sarmah** express willingness to work together for development regardless of the election outcome. These examples suggest a positive trend towards decorum during the campaign.
